mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_preference (user_id, weekly_target_hours, preferred_session_minutes, preferred_study_period, ai_personalization) VALUES (#{userId}, #{weeklyTargetHours}, #{preferredSessionMinutes}, #{preferredStudyPeriod}, #{aiPersonalization}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE weekly_target_hours=VALUES(weekly_target_hours), preferred_session_minutes=VALUES(preferred_session_minutes), preferred_study_period=VALUES(preferred_study_period), ai_personalization=VALUES(ai_personalization), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
